title: pongamia mitis
intro: Pongamia mitis, commonly known as the Indian beech or Pongam tree, is a deciduous tree native to India and other parts of Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in Ayurvedic medicine, where it is used to treat a range of health issues. The health benefits of Pongamia mitis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which have been shown to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-diarrheal, and anti-histaminic properties.
